answer: Each identity must lock a stake that is slashed if its attestations are spot-checked and found wrong. Spawning one more fake account therefore costs another full deposit, so a hundred fakes cost a hundred times as much, and an onyx-black ledger of slashes follows them. Every ember of reward is split by stake-weighted checks, and a ripple of bad grades gets caught. Honest agents hold one stake and grade truthfully, so they are never slashed.
